item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli forces detained a U.S. House candidate and activists during a West Bank olive harvest, while Israeli settlers assaulted Palestinian farmers and olive trees, injuring civilians. UNICEF reported that 340 children have been killed in Gaza despite a ceasefire, and an Israeli minister called for settling the entire West Bank, with a far-right rival offered a Gaza expulsion portfolio if he quits the election. Reuters noted the detained Americans were later released and AIPAC halted endorsements and direct contributions to candidates. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
